column1: # Adjective subcategorization frames (governed preposition) — the D63 frame-acquisition source
# WordNet has no structured subcat frame, so `convert.rs::governed_preposition` derives the governed
# preposition from the GLOSS — low-recall: it needs the lemma followed by its preposition IN ITS OWN
# gloss, which misses e.g. "dependent" (gloss "contingent on something else" — no "dependent on").
# This committed file supplies the governed preposition for such adjectives: the high-confidence output
# an LLM proposer gives for a gradable adjective's subcategorization frame. Offline LLM generation over
# the gradable-adjective inventory is the SCALE path; these are curated from the WRN first page. Read
# deterministically at import (`include_str!`) and consulted by `governed_preposition` as a FALLBACK
# after the gloss heuristic. TAB-separated: lemma <TAB> preposition (one of governed_preposition's
# PREPS). Blank lines and `#` comments are skipped.
